From 200,000 USDT to 3.8 million, dining at high-end restaurants, staying in five-star hotels—only took one month. No luck involved. It’s really hard work!!
Last year’s market wave, I did three rounds of rolling over positions, one more aggressive than the last, and in the end I multiplied by more than ten times. Many people ask me how I did it. I’ll tell you plainly—it’s simple, but 90% of people can’t really play this game.
What do you think people in the crypto market rely on to make big money? Technicals? Insider info? News? None of that. It all comes down to two words—timing.
Do you know how most people end up dying in this market?
Up 10% and you run.
Down 5% and you cut.
During normal times, you pretend with a 5% position.
When a real opportunity shows up, you get shaky and don’t dare enter.
Or else you do the opposite: you fight hard all the time, and when an opportunity arrives, you’re sitting in cash.
Those three rounds of rolling over for me—all depended on judging the start of the trend + controlling position sizing and timing.
At the beginning, don’t go all-in. Take only 20% to test the waters. Once the trend is confirmed, immediately scale up to half.
If the price breaks out with heavy volume, go all in.
If you get a pullback and it breaks the structure, cut—no hesitation.
My approach is ruthless, but the core isn’t gambling—it’s extreme discipline.
You get liquidated because you can’t hold.
You can’t make money because you don’t dare to step in.
If you want to roll over and turn things around, you must quit the three deadliest behaviors:
One is making a run the moment it goes up a little—then you’ll never catch the whole segment of the trend.
One is randomly opening high leverage without setting a stop-loss—you won’t even know how you died.
And the last one is getting carried away: after making some profits, you think you can flip to ten times, and then you end up giving it all back.
I’ve been doing this for more than a year, and a few brothers around me have also made it big:
One went from 8,000 USDT to 160,000.
Another—just one futures account, a little over 10,000—grew it to over 400,000.
It’s not that I’m superhuman. It’s that I don’t trade with emotions at all.
Timing, position control, and execution—if you get those three locked in, the market will naturally reward you.
Now the market is getting restless again. Let me say one thing—
Don’t just look at how much other people made. The key is whether you dare to seriously use your own little capital to play a real round.
Follow Yu-ge’s lead—at least you’ll see what real timing feels like.

In this CLARITY bill, what I think is truly worth paying attention to isn’t “yet another piece of regulatory legislation,” but the fact that the U.S. has finally begun to draw boundaries for Crypto.
The core change is still just two words: decentralization of authority.
For most eligible digital assets and spot markets, the regulatory focus shifts further toward the CFTC; the SEC will be responsible for assets with stronger “securities” characteristics. If this direction ultimately comes to fruition, it will be a major positive for the entire industry.
My view:
Mature assets like BTC and ETH will benefit most directly. Exchanges, compliant custody, stablecoins, and RWA will also enjoy the upside.
But I’m actually more focused on DeFi.
Because once real regulatory certainty is in place, institutional capital will finally dare to enter at scale. Before, people weren’t afraid that Crypto had no opportunity—it was that the rules weren’t set, so money wouldn’t come in.
So this time, I’ll be watching closely:
BTC / ETH
Compliant trading platforms
Stablecoins
RWA
DeFi
However, it’s not time to blindly go bullish yet. The Senate is expected to hold a key procedural vote on September 15—whether it can truly move forward is the next hurdle.
Regulation isn’t necessarily the end point for the market; it may actually be the starting point for the next wave of incremental capital.

Tonight Beijing time at 20:30, the U.S. August CPI will be released. Personally, I’m still somewhat bearish, but the focus is on the core data.
Yesterday’s PPI year-over-year rose 5.4%, slightly above expectations. However, the core month-over-month increased only 0.2%, below expectations, so it can’t be said that inflation has broadly deteriorated. What makes me more cautious is that energy price pressures are still there. The ECB also raised rates by 25 basis points again, indicating it’s not easy to expect rates to come down quickly.
Tonight the market expects CPI month-over-month at 0.4% and core month-over-month at 0.2%. If the core figure comes in at 0.3% or higher, it would strengthen expectations for the Fed to hike rates, putting more pressure on the rebound in BTC and ETH.
But if the core number is only 0.1%, and U.S. Treasury yields drop noticeably, I’ll reduce my confidence in a short-term bearish view. Being bearish has to adjust with the data—after prices rise, you can’t just label everything as a liquidity trap.
What I care about most is whether the rebound can hold after the data is released. Pushing higher and then dropping back to the original range would fit my bearish bias more.
#cpi #BTC #ETH

📰 Recovering 85% of Stolen BTC and Still Refusing to Pay Ransom—Why Is Blockstream So Tough?

According to Crypto Briefing, after the Liquid Network vulnerability attack, Blockstream successfully recovered about 85% of the stolen BTC and publicly refused the hackers’ ransom demands. This is a rare “show-of-steel” case in the industry—no money to make it go away, but instead taking back most of the assets.

One-sentence translation: Being hacked doesn’t necessarily mean you have to accept defeat—on-chain forensics plus legal pursuit may make it possible to get the money back.

In-depth analysis

Why does it matter?

In the past decade, the default script in the industry has been: hacked → negotiate privately → pay a 5–10% ransom → get back most of the assets. This “industry norm” essentially sets a price for the hacker, effectively incentivizing crime. By refusing to pay and recovering 85%, Blockstream is telling the attacker: the money on this chain is not easy to take.

When it doesn’t work: If the remaining 15% of assets are successfully mixed and washed out by the hackers and there’s no further recovery, the deterrence effect of this “tough demonstration” would be cut in half.

Impact on the market

In the short term, it has little effect on BTC price. BTC is currently at $77,040.13 (24h -1.21%); the trend is mainly driven by macro sentiment, so this news doesn’t provide an independent catalyst.

The real impact is in the medium term: if “refusing to pay ransom + recovering funds” becomes a standard playbook for exchanges and cross-chain protocols, the expected returns from hacker attacks would drop, and the frequency of security incidents could decrease—positive for market confidence as a slow-moving variable.

Reference example: In 2023, Euler Finance recovered most of the stolen funds through negotiations, but it paid a “white-hat bounty.” This time, Blockstream doesn’t even give the bounty—its stance is even tougher.

Trading approach

- Assets: BTC / ETH
- Direction: Neutral, slightly bullish on sentiment 📈
- Holding time: BTC 12 hours / ETH 24 hours

💡 My view: This is neutral-to-positive industry governance news, and it’s not worth opening a position on its own. BTC is normally ranging near $77,040, and within the next 12 hours I expect volatility within ±1.5%. If this window breaks below $76,000, it would suggest the move is driven by other bearish factors unrelated to this news. I’m 70% confident in this assessment; the remaining 30% I leave to the market—if I’m wrong, please go easy on me.

Post-quantum cryptography is being forced into place—can Bitcoin’s encryption system really stand up to quantum computers?
Financial institutions are being required to deploy post-quantum cryptography, putting blockchain security squarely on the agenda.

According to CryptoBriefing, post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is shifting from academic discussion to regulatory compliance requirements in the financial industry. Put simply: once quantum computers mature, the existing elliptic-curve signature schemes (used by both BTC and ETH) could theoretically be broken, meaning private keys are no longer “absolutely secure.” Regulators are therefore pushing banks and other regulated institutions to migrate to quantum-resistant algorithms in advance.

The key contradiction is this: blockchain is decentralized, so unlike banks, you can’t just order the entire network to upgrade overnight. Changing BTC’s signature scheme requires community consensus, which is far more difficult—by more than one order of magnitude.

One-sentence translation: banks can run first; the blockchain has to wait for the whole community to vote—this is the real exposure.

Market impact
- Short term: neutral to slightly emotional disruption. BTC at $77,036 (24h -1.15%), ETH at $2,464.99 (-0.09%): both are already grinding at the lows on reduced volume. This kind of news won’t cause shifts in capital flows; at most it gives shorts a new narrative angle. The quantum threat is a “ten-year-scale” issue—traders won’t rebalance for it.
- Medium term: positive in the longer run. Compliance frameworks leading the way means the industry can clear hazards early. BTC has already been discussing potential anti-quantum upgrade paths via soft forks such as OP_CAT. Regulatory push, in fact, suggests Crypto is being treated as “must-protect financial infrastructure.”

My take
Watch and wait—no real impact on price within 12 hours. For BTC, watch whether support below $77,036 holds; a breakdown would point toward the $99.37K area. ETH will follow the broader market. The value of this news is narrative-level: in the next bull market, “quantum security” will very likely become a new concept/sector, worth adding to your watchlist—but not a reason to trade right now. I’m 70% confident the price won’t move meaningfully; the remaining 30% is left to market sentiment.

- Coins: BTC / ETH

Analyst Cowen believes the lull in crypto search interest is not a normal cyclical phenomenon, but a sign that the industry’s reputation has been damaged.

According to a report by BeInCrypto, Benjamin Cowen from Into The Cryptoverse recently put forward an uncomfortable view: Google Trends and Wikipedia show sustained weakness in crypto-related searches. This isn’t the kind of cyclical coldness you see in the previous bear market—“nobody’s playing anymore.” Instead, it’s a structural issue: public impressions of cryptocurrencies have been permanently harmed.

He offered a comparison: at historical bear-market bottoms, search interest and app store download volumes often start to recover. Retail investors’ curiosity returns first, and then the price follows. But now the interest is flat, while the price is still hovering around $77,111—clearly diverging on both sides.

Market impact
- Short term: This is a bearish narrative driven by sentiment, but so far BTC is down only -1.09% in the last 24 hours, while ETH is down -0.03%. The market doesn’t look panicked. With searches staying quiet and price holding steady, it looks more like existing capital is trading rather than any new inflow of attention.
- Medium term: If Cowen is right, the next upswing may lack retail “fuel,” meaning the rally is highly constrained. But if it’s just cycle lag, a rebound in search interest could actually become a catch-up catalyst.

Liquid Network resumes block production; more than 80% of stolen Bitcoin has been returned

Launched by Blockstream in 2018, the Bitcoin sidechain Liquid Network is designed to enable faster settlement through the issuance of L-BTC backed by reserve Bitcoin. Over the weekend of September 6–7, the network was hit by a security vulnerability attack in which nearly 4,000 out of about 4,200 Bitcoin (worth roughly $320 million) were extracted. The network then paused all transactions, and an alliance comprising more than 80 exchanges, infrastructure companies, and asset management firms began handling the aftermath. The core facts are: Liquid Network has resumed block production, but as a precaution, trading and pegging operations are still suspended to monitor network stability. After the involved parties confirmed that affected nodes completed repairs, about 3,400 Bitcoin were returned. Currently, 598 Bitcoin (worth about $46 million) have not yet been recovered. The network team has published an emergency software update that fixes the vulnerability-related proof-verification cache issue, and it is actively working to restore the BTC and L-BTC reserve. From the mechanism, this incident differs from the typical paths of most crypto-hacking cases. According to disclosures, the funds were not stolen due to password or private-key leaks; instead, the related Bitcoin left via the normally authorized trading platform SideSwap. Blockstream’s investigation found that a software bug in the Elements system caused some of the implicated Bitcoin to be generated abnormally. Security experts noted that the vulnerability lies in the unit-processing layer of the transaction software, not in compromised keys or hardware modules. The attacker claimed to be a white-hat hacker via an on-chain message, demanding that each node’s vulnerability be fixed before returning the funds—subsequent return behavior aligns with that statement. The impact on the crypto market can be observed through three lines of development. First, because L-BTC depends on reserve Bitcoin backing, with reserves nearly depleted, the credit foundation of this model is directly shaken; outsiders will likely re-examine the security assumptions of consortium-custodied sidechains. Second, the incident puts infrastructure code audits in the spotlight, showing that proof-verification-like underlying components can also become single points of failure; timely node software updates and multi-party verifiability are expected to gain higher weight. Third, with block production resumed and most funds returned, the likelihood of further risk expanding is reduced. However, the pegging pause means related liquidity remains constrained, and institutions using this network may need to assess alternative settlement routes in the near term. Editor’s view: What can currently be confirmed is that the network has resumed block production, about 3,400 Bitcoin have been returned, and the root cause points to the proof-verification cache issue. What remains to be seen is whether the remaining 598 Bitcoin can be recovered, when pegging functionality will restart, how reserves will be replenished, and whether the alliance’s governance will introduce stricter multi-party validation mechanisms. It should be emphasized that the white-hat identity is still the attacker’s unilateral claim. Although the return actions are consistent with the statement, the final classification still requires further explanation by the project team and the alliance. Overall, this is a rare incident driven by a technical root cause. Its remediation approach may become a reference sample for similar sidechains and custody solutions.

content:
Liquid网络恢复出块，超八成被盗比特币已归还

由Blockstream于2018年推出的比特币侧链Liquid Network，旨在通过发行储备比特币背书的L-BTC实现更快结算。9月6日至7日周末，该网络遭遇安全漏洞攻击，约4200枚比特币中近4000枚（价值约3.2亿美元）被提取，网络随即暂停全部交易，由80余家交易所、基础设施公司和资产管理机构组成的联盟着手处置。核心事实是：Liquid Network已恢复区块生产，但作为预防措施，网络交易与挂钩操作目前仍处于暂停状态，以监控网络稳定性。在相关方确认受影响节点完成修复后，约3400枚比特币被归还；目前仍有598枚比特币（价值约4600万美元）尚未追回。网络方已发布紧急软件更新，修复引发漏洞的证明验证缓存问题，并正推进恢复BTC与L-BTC储备。从机制看，本次事件与多数加密黑客事件路径不同。据披露，资金并非因密码或私钥泄露被盗，相关比特币经由正常获准的交易平台SideSwap流出。Blockstream排查发现，Elements系统中的一个软件漏洞导致部分涉案比特币异常产生；安全专家指出，漏洞位于交易软件的单位处理层面，而非密钥或硬件模块被攻破。攻击者通过链上留言自称白帽黑客，要求先修复各节点漏洞再归还资金，后续归还行为与这一表态一致。对加密市场的影响可沿三条路径观察。第一，L-BTC依赖储备比特币背书，储备近乎耗尽直接动摇该模式的信用基础，外界将重新审视联盟托管型侧链的安全假设。第二，事件把基础设施代码审计推向台前，证明验证这类底层组件同样可能成为单点故障，节点软件的及时更新与多方可核验性预计获得更高权重。第三，恢复出块叠加大部分资金归还，降低了风险继续扩大的概率，但挂钩暂停意味着相关流动性仍受约束，使用该网络的机构短期内或需评估替代结算路径。编辑判断：目前可以确认的是网络已恢复出块、约3400枚比特币已归还、漏洞根因指向证明验证缓存问题。尚待观察的是剩余598枚比特币能否追回、挂钩功能何时重启、储备如何回补，以及联盟治理是否会引入更严格的多方校验机制。需要强调，白帽身份仍是攻击者的单方声称，归还行为虽与表态相符，最终定性有待项目方与联盟进一步说明。整体而言，这是一次少见的技术根因型安全事件，其处置方式或成为同类侧链与托管方案的参照样本。

According to CryptoBriefing, Trump publicly pressured Kevin Warsh, the Chairman of the Federal Reserve, directly threatening the independence of his position. In plain terms: the president wants the central bank to do things his way, and the political risk of monetary policy is surging.

One-sentence translation: The Fed—the world’s “anchor” for global finance—is starting to shake, and money is looking for a new safe harbor.

In-depth analysis

Why does this news matter?

Central bank independence isn’t an academic concept—it’s the foundation of global asset pricing. The credibility of the U.S. dollar rests on a single premise: monetary policy is determined by technical officials, not manipulated by politics. If Trump’s pressure campaign keeps escalating, the market will start pricing in a “discount for Fed independence”—U.S. Treasuries and the dollar would face pressure. And the endpoint of this logic chain often points toward non-sovereign assets.

Historically, whenever doubts arise about Fed independence (the Nixon era, or Trump’s attacks on Powell in 2019), attention toward gold and decentralized assets tends to spike. What’s different this time is that the crypto market is already big enough and institutionalized enough. BTC is now $79,360, up 1.18% over 24h; ETH is $2,503, up 1.21%—the market is already voting with its feet.

Market impact

Short term: Uncertainty itself is a bullish factor for rate-cut expectations—if Warsh yields to political pressure, easing could come earlier and stronger. Liquidity expectations are the most direct fuel for BTC.

Medium term: If U.S. dollar credibility is damaged and that becomes the narrative, the rationale for institutions to allocate to BTC upgrades from “speculation” to “hedging political interference in sovereign currencies.” This is one of the strongest narratives since 2020.

Invalidation conditions: If Warsh publicly pushes back hard and Trump backs down, the “independence” narrative cools off quickly—this bullish logic would basically be void. If BTC breaks below $79,360, that would also show the market doesn’t buy it.

📰 Trump pushes data centers—why did the GOP start arguing internally first?

According to Crypto Briefing, Trump is aggressively pushing for data center development, but has created an awkward situation within the Republican Party: some GOP lawmakers are resisting local data center expansion. Clear rifts have emerged within the party over energy, land use, and electricity pricing. On the surface, this is a disagreement over infrastructure; in reality, it’s a three-way power struggle involving AI compute capacity, electricity resources, and political elections.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?

Data centers are the physical foundation of this current AI narrative, and also a core direction for miners’ transition. The past two years of stories from Bitcoin mining firms like RIOT and MARA have essentially been “convert the mining site into AI server rooms.” The logic is straightforward: existing high-value power infrastructure can be repackaged and sold at a premium.

The problem now is that data center expansion requires massive electricity. Where does the power come from, who pays the bill, and whether construction is in whose backyard—all of it is political. Republicans have traditionally been pro–traditional energy and pro-development. But voters in their constituencies don’t want their communities surrounded by giant data centers, or for electricity bills to rise. That contradiction was previously suppressed, but now Trump has brought it to the front stage himself.

In plain terms, this is the first time the AI infrastructure sprint has hit the wall of political reality. Policy rollouts are being blocked, and in the short term the imaginative space behind AI compute concepts may get discounted—cooling the miner transition narrative as well.

Market impact

In the short run, this has more of an indirect sentiment effect on BTC and ETH—neutral to noise. BTC is currently $79,078 and has only moved about 0.84% over 24h; ETH at $2,494.55 is also about 0.84%. The market basically isn’t treating this as a big deal, and capital is waiting for more direct catalysts.

What’s worth watching in the mid term is this: if data center policy keeps getting tug-of-wars at the state level, rising expectations for electricity costs could feed into mining economics, affecting miners’ decisions on holding versus selling—indirectly impacting the BTC supply side. But that chain is too long; don’t expect it to cause an immediate sell-off.

One-sentence translation: The electricity AI needs is becoming a political issue, but it hasn’t reached the point of impacting coin prices.

Trading approach

- Asset: BTC

💡 My view: Wait and watch. This news is worth recording in your notebook, but not worth changing positions for. Only if later there are material developments—such as “federal-level data center subsidy legislation being blocked”—would that become a new variable. 据 Binance Square，Ripple 首席法务官 Stuart Alderoty 正在游说参议员，推动 CLARITY 法案在 9 月 15 日的程序性投票中过关。Ripple 给出的筹码很直白：美国有 6700 万加密持币者、行业支撑 23.2 万个岗位、贡献 550 亿美元经济产值。法案核心是建立联邦数字资产监管框架，把数字商品现货市场划给 CFTC 监管，启动正式辩论需要至少 60 票。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？

说白了，这是行业从“被打压方”变成“有谈判筹码方”的标志性时刻。Ripple 拿出来的三个数字不是给币圈看的，是给参议员看的——6700 万持币者就是 6700 万张潜在选票。中期选举年，这个数字比任何游说献金都硬。

从监管周期看，CLARITY 法案如果过了程序性投票，意味着加密行业第一次有机会拿到联邦层面的明确规则：什么是证券、什么是商品、归谁管。这个确定性是机构资金进场的前提条件，没有它，ETF 之后的下一波大资金一直停在门口观望。

关联性上，XRP 今天涨 1.69% 到 $1.423，明显强于 BTC 的 0.32%，市场已经在提前定价 Ripple 的政治胜利。BTC 在 $79,033 附近横盘，缺的就是这种催化剂。

对市场的影响

传导路径很清晰：法案过程序性投票 → 监管确定性提升 → 机构资金入场通道打开 → 直接支撑 BTC/ETH 价格。

一句话翻译：这不是普通的监管新闻，而是决定“美国加密市场到底算合法产业还是灰色地带”的分水岭投票。

如果投票延期或失败，XRP 回吐涨幅，BTC 回踩 $77,500 支撑，这条利多逻辑作废，届时我的判断撤回。

White-hat hackers siphon nearly 4,000 BTC—why did Blockstream receive the warning early but ignore it?

Blockstream was accused of overlooking warnings from its security team, and then nearly 4,000 BTC on the Liquid network were taken under the control of a white-hat hacker.

According to Bitcoin.com, Calle, head of the Bitcoin Red Team, publicly stated that before the incident occurred, they had already disclosed the relevant vulnerabilities in the Liquid network to Blockstream, but the emails went unanswered. In this incident, a white-hat hacker exploited the vulnerability to control nearly 4,000 BTC—at the current $77,293.71, worth more than $300 million. This security team has previously disclosed thousands of vulnerabilities and is not an unknown group. The key controversy right now is whether the vulnerability was never reported, or whether it was reported but simply left aside.

💡 Negative takeaway: Regardless of which is true, the trustworthiness of Liquid as the infrastructure for a BTC sidechain has been discounted.

Market impact
- Short term: Sentiment is bearish. Even though this was a white-hat operation and no funds were actually stolen, a headline about a “$300 million vulnerability” is enough to scare away some cautious, on-the-fence capital. BTC is currently $77,293.71 (24h -0.91%), already in a weak range, and this kind of news will only make careful people more cautious. ETH $2,467.75 is basically flat, so the linkage effect is limited.
- Medium term: If “ignoring the warning” is confirmed, damage to Blockstream’s reputation could spill over into broader trust evaluations for the entire sidechain/cross-chain track, and institutional due diligence on these infrastructures will become more stringent.

One-sentence translation: The money is fine for now, but “you only found out after something happened that someone had warned you earlier” hurts trust more than the lost coins themselves.

My take
Slightly bearish in the short term, but the level is limited. The white-hat incident didn’t result in an actual loss of funds; it’s more of a sentiment-negative rather than a fundamental-negative. BTC will most likely digest this news in the $76,000–$77,500 range. What really needs watching next: if Blockstream can’t come up with a strong response, or if the details reveal the problem is even more serious, that’s when it could test support at $77,293.71. I’m 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% depends on Blockstream’s PR quality. If they miss the mark, I’ll just watch with a small position.

白帽黑客卷走近4000枚BTC，Blockstream为什么早收到预警却没理？

Blockstream被指忽视安全团队漏洞预警，随后Liquid网络近4000枚BTC被白帽黑客控制。

据 Bitcoin.com，Bitcoin Red Team 负责人 Calle 公开表示，在事件发生前他们就已经向 Blockstream 披露了 Liquid 网络的相关漏洞，但邮件石沉大海。这次事件中，一名白帽黑客利用该漏洞控制了近 4,000 BTC——按当前 $77,293.71 算，价值超过 3 亿美元。这支安全团队此前已披露过数千个漏洞，不是无名之辈。目前关键争议在于：漏洞到底是没被报告，还是被报告了却被晾在一边。

💡 利空：无论哪种情况，Liquid 作为 BTC 侧链的基础设施可信度都被打了折扣。

对市场的影响
- 短期：情绪面偏空。虽然这次是白帽操作、资金没被偷，但"3亿美元的漏洞"这种标题足够吓退一部分观望资金。BTC 现在 $77,293.71（24h -0.91%），本身就在弱势区间，这种消息只会让谨慎的人更谨慎。ETH $2,467.75 基本走平，联动效应有限。
- 中期：如果"忽视预警"被坐实，Blockstream 的声誉受损会传导到整个侧链/跨链赛道的信任评估上，机构对这些基础设施的尽调会更严格。

一句话翻译：钱暂时没事，但"出了事才发现有人早就提醒过你"，比丢币本身更伤信任。

我的判断
短期偏空，但级别有限。白帽事件没有实际资金损失，属于情绪利空而非实质利空，BTC 大概率在 $76,000-$77,500 区间消化这个消息。真正要盯的是后续：如果 Blockstream 拿不出有力的回应，或漏洞细节曝光显示问题更严重，那才会往 $77,293.71 支撑去测试。这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成看 Blockstream 的公关水平，说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位观察。

subTitle:
浮亏算什么？慌才是真的亏！行情上蹿下跳，做投资久了才懂：涨跌是常态，被套是标配。

谁还没踩过几个坑？账面一飘绿，心里就开始演灾难片。但越是这种时候，越不能上头——盲目加仓、着急割肉，等于亲手把小亏养成大亏。投资不是一夜暴富的赌局，拼的不是一把赚多少，而是能不能守住底线、管住手、稳住心态。风物长宜放眼量，别因一时涨跌慌。耐心等机会，比频繁出手更值钱。市场永远不缺机会，缺的是冷静的你。

前阵子跟一位前辈聊天，他讲起早年踩坑往事：重仓遇上回调，账户一路缩水，浮亏天天涨，夜里翻来覆去睡不着。脑子里只有一个念头：赶紧加仓摊薄成本，一把回本！结果呢？越急越乱，越乱越亏。追着波动频繁操作，非但没解套，反而把本金越做越少。
后来他索性停手，沉下心重新梳理持仓逻辑，不再被短期涨跌牵着鼻子走，耐心等周期回归。慢慢地，局面一点点回暖。他说了一句话，我记到现在：投资里最难熬的，不是下跌本身，是被套之后那颗急于翻盘的心。很多亏损，不是亏在行情，是亏在慌乱。

沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春。市场有起有落，回调是常态，被套是很多人的必经一关。如果你正处在浮亏的煎熬期——千万别病急乱投医！先停下来，冷静评估：
· 哪些持仓基本面逻辑还在？
· 哪些已经超出自己的承受能力？
别指望一夜解套。解套从来不是靠赌一把，是靠耐心、风控和理性。市场永远有新机会，但本金只有一份。稳住心态，守住底线，熬过低谷，才有资格等行情回暖。投资是一场漫长的修行，别让一时得失把自己困死。共勉，所有在投资路上慢慢打磨自己的人。

So what if you’re at a floating loss? Panic is the real loss! The market jumps up and down—after you’ve been investing for a while, you’ll understand: price moves up and down are the norm, being stuck in a losing position is basically standard equipment.

Who hasn’t stepped into a few pitfalls? When the books suddenly turn green, and panic starts as if a disaster movie is starting to play—but at times like these, you must not get carried away. Blindly adding positions or rushing to cut losses is like turning a small loss into a big one with your own hands. Investing isn’t a gamble to get rich overnight. What matters isn’t how much you can make in a single round, but whether you can hold the line, keep control of your actions, and stay calm. A long view is always best—don’t be spooked by short-term price swings. Patience for opportunities is more valuable than constantly making moves. The market is never short of opportunities; what it lacks is a calm version of you.

#ETH  The one thing you should absolutely avoid with small capital: the moment you see hope, you start risking your life to gamble

Many people, when their principal is only a few hundred U or a few thousand U, feel that their funds are too small. They think that to grow quickly, they must take oversized positions, go all-in, and catch one big move.

But reality is often that the money hasn’t even started rolling yet, and the person is already taken out by their own actions.

Yingge has seen many such cases: at first, they make a bit of profit from a few small market moves. As the account starts to grow, their mindset inflates. They feel like they’ve found a way to make money, and then they start going all-in chasing hot spots, chasing breakouts, and selling at the wrong times.

Then once the direction is judged wrong, a single pullback wipes out all the profits they accumulated before—sometimes even affecting the principal.

In fact, if small capital wants to grow, the most important thing isn’t betting on one opportunity. It’s ensuring you always have the right to stay in the market.

Position sizing must be controlled. Don’t press all your chips onto the table from the very beginning. Market opportunities will always be there. But if one operational mistake causes you to have no principal left to participate in the next trade, then that’s the real problem.

Also, don’t try to catch every kind of market move. When others are making money, don’t rush in. If you see a crash, don’t blindly try to bottom-fish. If you haven’t clearly seen the trend, haven’t judged the position correctly, and haven’t calculated the risk properly—better to miss it than to jump in recklessly.

The most important lesson in trading is accepting that you’ll make mistakes. Nobody can guarantee every single trade will be right. Cutting losses promptly when you’re wrong is far better than holding an incorrect position and fantasizing about a rebound. Many people don’t lose because of one mistake—they lose because they refuse to admit they’re wrong, and end up getting trapped deeper and deeper.

After you’ve earned profits, you also need to know how to protect them. If the market is going smoothly, you can take profit in batches. Don’t always think about grabbing the entire move. There’s never a point where you’ve “made all the money” the market has. But once your principal is lost, starting over again is much harder.

Growing the account is never about getting rich by luck. It’s about repeatedly doing the right things—so that small advantages accumulate slowly $牛来 

First, keep the principal alive. Then talk about amplifying returns.

Truly great traders aren’t the ones who catch every opportunity. They are the ones who have already prepared before the opportunity even arrives.

#ETH 小资金最忌讳的一件事：刚看到希望，就开始拿命去赌

很多人本金只有几百U、几千U的时候，总觉得自己资金太少，想快速做大就必须重仓、梭哈、抓一波大的

但现实往往是，钱还没滚起来，人先被自己的操作搞出局了

盈哥见过不少人，前面靠几次小行情赚了一点，账户开始增长，心态也跟着膨胀，觉得自己已经找到赚钱的方法，然后开始满仓追热点、追涨杀跌

结果一旦方向判断错，一次回撤就把之前积累的利润全部打回去，甚至本金都受到影响

其实小资金想做大，最重要的不是赌一次机会，而是保证自己一直有资格留在市场里

仓位一定要控制，不要一开始就把所有筹码压上。市场机会永远都有，但如果一次操作失误导致没有本金参与下一次行情，那才是真正的问题

还有就是不要什么行情都想抓，别人赚钱的时候别急着冲，看到暴跌也别盲目抄底。趋势没看清，位置没判断好，风险没计算明白，宁愿错过，也不要乱上

交易里最重要的一课，就是接受错误
没有人能保证每一单都对，错了及时止损，比拿着错误仓位幻想反弹强得多。很多人不是亏在一次失误，而是不愿承认错误，最后越套越深

赚到利润以后，也要懂得保护。行情走顺了可以分批落袋，不要总想着吃完整段走势，市场的钱永远赚不完，但本金亏掉之后，重新开始会很难

滚仓从来不是靠运气暴富，而是不断重复正确的事情，让小优势慢慢积累$牛来 

先让本金活下来，再谈收益放大
真正厉害的交易者，不是每次都抓住机会，而是在机会来之前，已经做好了准备

Why Canada suddenly gave the green light to tokenized deposits? Is OSFI really allowing it this time?

Canada’s regulator OSFI has allowed banks to make tokenized deposits, and the wall between traditional finance and blockchain has cracked open further.

According to Crypto Briefing, Canada’s Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI) has officially cleared tokenized deposits, allowing licensed banks to issue deposits as on-chain tokens. Put simply, it means putting the liability side of traditional banks on-chain and bridging it with the crypto ecosystem. This isn’t Canada acting on a whim—Singapore and Europe are both rolling out similar pilots, and OSFI’s move effectively follows the global regulatory mainstream direction. For Canadian local institutions, the compliance path has gone from “grey” to clearly written in black and white.

In one sentence: banks’ money can be put on-chain legally and transparently, and the door for institutions to enter has opened a bit wider.

Market impact
- Short term: A slow-burn positive, not an immediate pump. BTC is currently at $99,83,186.01 (24h -1.58%), ETH at $2,465.2 (-0.62%). The market is still digesting overall pullback sentiment. This news is more of emotional support than a spark.
- Medium term: Substantive positive. Bank infrastructure directly connects to public chains, meaning future channels for institutional capital in and out should become smoother. Canada is a G7 country, and such policies have a demonstration effect—regulatory follow-through in the U.S. and Europe becomes more likely.

My take
I’m bullish on the direction, but the pace should be slowed. Regulatory easing-type positives are never realized on the same day—it’s something that builds bricks for the next round of institutional narrative. If BTC can hold near $99.83K, and this compliance tailwind keeps stacking up, the medium-term structure is likely bullish. If it breaks below $99.83K, that would mean macro liquidity pressure is outweighing regulatory momentum, and then you’d need to reassess and wait. I’m 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% I leave to the market—if I’m wrong, go easy on me, and I’m only holding a small position. ETH follows the broader market; its upside elasticity depends on BTC’s mood.

加拿大为什么突然给代币化存款开绿灯？OSFI这次是真放行

加拿大监管机构OSFI允许银行做代币化存款，传统金融和区块链的墙又裂开一道。

据 Crypto Briefing，加拿大金融机构监管局（OSFI）正式放行代币化存款，允许持牌银行把存款以链上代币形式发行。说白了，就是让传统银行的负债端上链，和加密体系打通。这不是加拿大一时兴起——新加坡、欧洲都在推类似试点，OSFI这步等于跟进了全球监管主流方向。对加拿大本地机构来说，合规路径从灰色变成了白纸黑字。

一句话翻译：银行的钱可以名正言顺地上链了，机构入场的门又开大了一点。

- 短期：属于慢变量利好，不会立刻拉盘。BTC 现报 $99.83,186.01（24h -1.58%），ETH $2,465.2（-0.62%），市场还在消化整体回调情绪。这消息更多是情绪托底，不是点火器。
- 中期：实质性利好。银行基础设施直接对接公链，意味着未来机构资金进出的通道更顺。加拿大是G7国家，这类政策有示范效应，美国、欧洲的监管跟进概率上升。

我的判断
方向我看多，但节奏要放慢看。监管松绑类的利好从来不是当天兑现的，它是给下一轮机构叙事添砖。BTC 在 $99.83K 附近如果能守住，配合这波合规利好堆积，中期结构偏多；跌穿 $99.83K 则说明宏观资金面压制了监管面，那就得重新观望。这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场，说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位在场内。ETH 跟随大盘，弹性看 BTC 脸色。

BTC slips below the axis but still mouths off; don’t talk about a bottom until the funding rate turns negative

The midday session is green in a neat, orderly way—so neat even the market can’t be bothered to paint over it with a token red candle.

BTC is at 77,076, down 1.68%, just sitting below the 77,160 axis. This is the most tortifying spot: if you call it weak, the low at 76,402 is still holding; if you call it strong, yesterday’s 78,542 breakout buyers now have a different kind of story to tell. The market’s favorite trick is to make people who hesitate at both ends get punished together.

XRP is the laggard—down over 3% and then suddenly gone, smashing through the 1.35 axis from 1.3928, with a low at 1.3282. The coin that was yelling the loudest usually falls the hardest. The next test is 1.31—if you can’t hold it, don’t ask how much further there is; the answer is: the market is educating investors.

ETH looks relatively respectable, down only 0.828%. At 2,458 it’s still standing; volume is 8.7B, second only to BTC’s 10.75B. The funding rate is 9.25e-06—almost flat. Bulls and bears are both waiting for BTC to make up its mind. Above 2,479 being reclaimed means sentiment can finally be repaired; if 2,398 is lost, the catch-up selloff will come fast and hard—don’t blame anyone for not reminding you.

What’s most worth thinking about is BTC’s funding rate: even after falling this much, it’s still sitting positive (8.675e-05). Put simply, the longs haven’t admitted defeat. As long as the funding rate doesn’t turn negative and the panic positioning hasn’t cleared out, the so-called bottom is still missing that last breath. On the flip side, if the low at 76,402 from last night is broken, it would directly hand over the daily buy point at 75,777—that’s the number to watch today.

BNB is the most laid-back: down 0.842% to 717, with volume only 0.39B. No one is smashing it, and no one is catching it. The survival philosophy of a laid-back coin: if you don’t make noise, you won’t get hit.

Conclusion: slightly bearish. Before 77,918 is reclaimed, treat any rebound as just a breather. Drifting lower isn’t an opportunity, and going sideways isn’t safety—this market flips its face without giving advance notice.

U.S. August core inflation monthly rate higher than expected

U.S. August inflation data were released before the Federal Reserve’s September policy meeting, with the market focused on whether underlying price pressures are continuing to cool. Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics show that in August, the core consumer price index (CPI) rose 2.4% year over year, in line with expectations and down from the prior 2.5%. However, the core CPI increased 0.3% month over month, exceeding the market estimate of 0.2%. This means that on an annual basis, core inflation is still slowing, but on a monthly basis, price pressure has not fully returned to a more moderate range.

For overall CPI, August climbed 3.4% year over year and 0.4% month over month, both matching market expectations. By component, energy prices rose 2.1% month over month, reversing July’s decline. Gasoline prices rose 3.9%, contributing more than one-third of the overall monthly CPI increase. Food prices rose 0.1% month over month and 2.7% year over year. Within the core items, housing costs rose 0.3%, and lodging, communication services, airfares, and education prices also moved higher. Meanwhile, healthcare and motor vehicle insurance helped buffer core inflation.

Logically, the data present a combination of “the total matches expectations, the core monthly rate is somewhat stronger, and the core annual rate is easing.” At the factual level, a core monthly rate higher than expected could heighten policymakers’ concerns about stickier service prices and secondary (pass-through) inflation. But the year-over-year decline indicates the inflation trend is not simply accelerating upward in a single direction. Therefore, the market’s assessment of the subsequent interest-rate path may depend more on how the Fed weighs energy shocks, housing costs, and service prices.

For the crypto market, the impact pathway mainly comes from macro liquidity expectations and risk appetite. If investors believe stronger-than-expected core inflation will delay easing or increase the weight of rate-hike discussions, expectations for higher yields on dollar-denominated assets could suppress valuations of risk assets; highly volatile assets such as BTC and ETH would typically face greater discounting pressure. Conversely, if the market places more emphasis on the core year-over-year figure continuing to fall, expectations that liquidity will improve could be supported.

Editor’s note: This report is not a one-way signal, but a differentiated one. Near-term volatility may stem from the market repricing the policy meeting. In the medium term, it will still be important to observe whether subsequent employment, energy, and services inflation data together point to price pressures accelerating again. For crypto investors, the key is not the single CPI number itself, but how it changes interest-rate expectations, U.S. dollar liquidity, and portfolio positioning in risk assets.

#U.S. August core CPI rises 0.3% month over month, exceeding expectations #BTC #ETH #BNB

美国8月核心通胀月率高于预期

美国8月通胀数据在美联储9月政策会议前公布，市场关注点集中在核心价格压力是否继续降温。美国劳工部数据显示，8月核心消费者价格指数同比增长2.4%，与预估一致，低于前值2.5%；但核心CPI环比增长0.3%，高于0.2%的市场预估。这意味着从年度口径看，核心通胀仍在放缓，但从月度变化看，价格压力并未完全回到更温和区间。

整体CPI方面，8月同比增长3.4%，环比增长0.4%，均符合市场预期。分项看，能源价格环比上涨2.1%，扭转7月下降走势，其中汽油价格上涨3.9%，对整体CPI月度涨幅贡献超过三分之一。食品价格环比上涨0.1%，同比上涨2.7%。核心项内部，住房价格上涨0.3%，酒店住宿、通信服务、机票和教育价格也出现上行；医疗、机动车保险等项目则对核心通胀形成一定缓冲。

逻辑上，这组数据呈现“总量符合预期、核心月率偏强、核心年率回落”的组合。事实层面，核心月率高于预期会增加政策制定者对服务价格黏性和二次通胀的警惕；但同比回落又说明通胀趋势并非单向升温。因此，市场对后续利率路径的判断可能更依赖美联储如何权衡能源冲击、住房成本与服务价格。

对加密市场而言，影响路径主要来自宏观流动性预期和风险偏好。若投资者认为核心通胀偏强会推迟宽松或提高加息讨论权重，美元资产收益率上行预期可能压制风险资产估值，BTC、ETH等高波动资产通常会面临更高折现压力。反过来，如果市场更重视核心同比继续回落，则加密资产对流动性改善的预期可能获得支撑。

编辑观察是，这份报告不是单边信号，而是一个分化信号。短期波动可能来自市场对政策会议的重新定价；中期仍需观察后续就业、能源与服务通胀数据是否共同指向价格压力再加速。对于加密投资者，关键不是单个CPI数字本身，而是它如何改变利率预期、美元流动性和风险资产仓位。

As soon as the CPI came out, the big BTC cake was directly pushed up to 76,0–76,1k, and gold also flashed down a bit. The numbers themselves aren’t particularly explosive—overall CPI was 3.4% year-on-year and 0.4% month-on-month, both landing right within expectations; core CPI at 2.4% year-on-year also matched expectations. What really stings the market is core CPI month-on-month at 0.3%, when the expectation was only 0.2%. Oil prices have been expensive lately, bond yields are heading toward 5%, and rate-hike expectations were lifted again—first moves were made by the shorts.

But the needle didn’t hold. After the liquidity sweep around 76.0k, the funds quickly pulled the price back. Later it even once again stood above 79k, with the high around 79.3–79.8k. At the moment, it’s probably still hovering in the 78.8–79.3k range. Ethereum is a bit stronger than BTC: after the data, it had a push toward 2600, and it feels more comfortable than earlier today. In essence, the whole market has partially digested the panic created by yesterday’s PPI dump with a long lower wick.

The market logic isn’t complicated. The data wasn’t bad enough to make people collapse immediately, and it wasn’t good enough to give anyone confidence to chase 80k. After the shorts swept at 76.0k, the longs entered in the deep-dip area; the middle leg was a two-way liquidation. The 80k level is still a hurdle—it’s unlikely to be settled tonight, and the 82k that was touched last week is even less likely to be resolved tonight. This 76.0k area should be treated as a temporary floor for tonight; if it breaks, things would look ugly.

Altcoins are still moving with BTC, with no independent main narrative. ZEC’s privacy coin is still hovering at a high level—whoever chases the top is likely to get hit. The small coins are still bouncing where they should, with no relationship to the trend. This week’s ETF flow is already not as smooth as the first few weeks: institutions slowed down a bit around the data week, which is normal.

The real show next Wednesday will be the Fed’s interest-rate decision. Tonight’s bounce looks more like a “buyback after not being worse” rather than a new trend. If your position is light, keep it light; don’t add leverage before the weekend and before the decision. For those trading short-term, watch whether 79.0k can be reclaimed by Monday; if it can’t hold, it will likely have to grind in the 77.6–78.0k area.

content:
CPI 一出来，大饼直接插到 7.60–7.61 万，黄金也跟着闪崩一下。数字本身不算爆炸——整体 CPI 年率 3.4%、月率 0.4%，都卡在预期上；核心年率 2.4% 也符合预期。真正刺市场的是核心月率 0.3%，预期只要 0.2%。油价这阵子又贵，债息往 5% 靠，加息预期一下子又被抬高，空头那边先动手了。

但针没站住。扫完 7.60 这块流动性之后，资金很快把价格拉回去，后面一度重新站上 7.9 万，最高有看到 7.93–7.98 附近。眼下大概还在 7.88–7.93 这块晃。以太坊比大饼更猛一点，数据后有过往 2600 冲的动作，现在也比早上舒服。全市场等于把昨天 PPI 砸出来的恐慌，用一根长下影给消化了一部分。

盘面逻辑其实不复杂。数据没有差到让人立刻崩，也没有好到让人敢追 8 万。空头在 7.60 扫完货，多头在深跌区接，中间那一截是双向爆仓。8 万还是过不去的坎，上周摸过的 8.2 更别想今晚解决。下面这条 7.60 今晚先当临时底看，破了才会难看。

山寨还是跟大饼走，没有自己的主线。ZEC 这波隐私币还在高位晃，谁追高谁容易挨打。小币该蹦的还在蹦，跟趋势没关系。ETF 这周已经没有前几周那么顺，机构在数据周前后减了一点速度，正常。
下周三美联储议息才是正戏。今晚这波反弹，更像是“没有更差”之后的回补，不是新趋势。仓位轻的继续轻，杠杆别在周末和议息前加。想做短线的，就看 7.90 能不能收到周一；收不住，大概率还得回 7.76–7.80 磨。

#加息  #CPI  #BTC 

Are we entering a rate-hike cycle now? What is everyone afraid of?

The last bear market of Bitcoin and the US stock market in 2022–2023 was the most aggressive year of rate hikes in US history. Interest rates rose from 0% to as high as 5.25%, taking only 14 months.

It was also the year with the sharpest surge in CPI data. As everyone knows, due to the massive liquidity stimulus during the pandemic, the last CPI peak reached 9.1. But that also helped fuel the super bull market of 2021.

2022–2023: the most aggressive rate-hike cycle in history
Bitcoin fell -77%
NASDAQ fell -37%

Figure 1 shows the rate-hike data from 2022–2023. The intervals and the magnitude of the hikes were extremely frequent. This was reflected simultaneously in Figure 2 through the price movements of Bitcoin or the US stock market. The duration of the bear market, the smoothness of the declines, and the magnitude of the drop were all quite significant.

But as of September 11, 2026, the latest US CPI is: 3.4% (the latest CPI data will be released tonight). The latest interest rate is: 3.5%. Compared with the previous rate-hike cycle, this data is already very mild. The interest-rate market has already priced in expectations of two or three more rate hikes over the next year. As long as we do not truly enter a rate-hike cycle—for example, if the increases persist for a year or if there’s another 5-point hike—then at the macro level, it’s just noise. Would anyone really think the US will keep raising rates to 10%? If that were the case, the empire would truly be in serious trouble.

To reiterate:
As long as we don’t enter a rate-hike cycle, two or three rate hikes should be treated as noise. There’s nothing to worry about—just make good use of the pullback opportunity in September.

有人问现在还能不能追，我更愿意反过来想——如果这是假突破，为什么回踩时连前高支撑都碰不到？关键逻辑就两条：一是量价配合健康，突破有量、回踩缩量，这是典型的续涨形态；二是市场情绪从恐慌转向犹豫，而犹豫期往往才是趋势中段，真正的一致看多还没来。风险收益比上，上方空间打开后，下方支撑密集，这种结构下顺势比逆势舒服得多。当然，不是说没有回撤风险，短线涨速偏快，随时可能插针洗一波浮筹。

但只要关键支撑不破，结构就没坏。我看的是方向，不是一两根K线的涨跌。$ETH 这个位置，冷静比冲动值钱。

与雄叔同行，见天地盈亏。

Know more.) Crypto ETF FAQs What is an ETF? An Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) is an investment vehicle or an index that tracks the price of an underlying asset. ETFs can not only track a single asset, but a group of assets and sectors. For example, a Bitcoin ETF tracks Bitcoin's price. ETF is a tool used by investors to gain exposure to a certain asset. Is Bitcoin futures ETF approved? Yes. The first Bitcoin futures ETF in the US was approved by the US Securities & Exchange Commission in October 2021. A total of seven Bitcoin futures ETFs have been approved, with more than 20 still waiting for the regulator's permission. The SEC says that the cryptocurrency industry is new and subject to manipulation, which is why it has been delaying crypto-related futures ETFs for the last few years. Is Bitcoin spot ETF approved? Yes. The SEC approved in January 2024 the listing and trading of several Bitcoin spot Exchange-Traded Funds, opening the door to institutional capital and mainstream
investors to trade the main crypto currency. The decision was hailed by the industry as a game changer. Which are the pros and cons of crypto ETFs? The main advantage of crypto ETFs is the possibility of gaining exposure to a cryptocurrency without ownership, reducing the risk and cost of holding the asset. Other pros are a lower learning curve and higher security for investors since ETFs take charge of securing the underlying asset holdings. As for the main drawbacks, the main one is that as an investor you can't have direct ownership of the asset, or, as they say in crypto, "not your keys, not your coins." Other disadvantages are higher costs associated with holding crypto since ETFs charge fees for active management. Finally, even though investing in ETFs reduces the risk of holding an asset, price swings in the underlying cryptocurrency are likely to be reflected in the investment vehicle too.

What Is Blockchain? A Simple Explanation for Beginners

You’ve probably heard the word “blockchain” many times in crypto. But what exactly is it?

Think of a blockchain as a digital record book that is maintained across a network rather than being controlled by just one central authority.

Here’s the basic idea:

1️⃣ A transaction or piece of data is created.
2️⃣ The network verifies it according to its rules.
3️⃣ Valid transactions can be grouped into a block.
4️⃣ The block is added to the existing chain.
5️⃣ The record becomes part of the blockchain history.

🔐 One important feature is that blockchain data can be difficult to alter once confirmed, depending on the blockchain's design and consensus mechanism.

Bitcoin uses blockchain technology to record BTC transactions.

Solana sees a record 263,000 new tokens minted in a single day: on-chain activity is back— or is it just more noise?

Solana minted 263,000 new tokens in a day, setting a historic high and directly affecting the ecosystem’s on-chain activity.

According to CoinTelegraph, the number of new tokens issued on the Solana network in a single day reached 263,000, breaking the all-time record. Most of it comes from the memecoin launch platform Pump.fun, which accounts for the vast majority of new tokens across various launchpads. In plain terms: the threshold to issue tokens on-chain is so low it’s almost zero—anyone can create a coin in seconds with a cost of just a few dollars. The result is explosive supply.

One-sentence takeaway: On-chain activity really is picking up, but a sizable portion of the increase is one-off memecoin noise.

Market impact
- Short term: It has basically no impact on BTC $77,658.33 or ETH $2,500.35; this kind of data can’t even stir mainstream fund sentiment. For SOL (current price $101.48, 24h +2.17%), it’s a marginally positive narrative—active addresses and fee revenue may rise, but don’t expect this to pull the market up by itself. Neutral to mildly bullish—nothing more.
- Medium term: What’s truly worth watching is the regulatory angle. With 260,000 new tokens minted in a day, most are likely unreviewed speculative products. If the SEC ever turns its attention to the launchpad model, this kind of data is ready-made ammunition. The other side of record token issuance is that regulatory exposure is also hitting new highs.

My view
I’m neutral on this: the data itself isn’t a reason to trade. On-chain activity is real, but the quality is questionable—of the 260,000 tokens, the chance that they last more than a week is probably less than 1%. As evidence of activity for the SOL ecosystem, it supports activity but doesn’t signal a trend. BTC is holding steady around $77,658.33, ETH is up 3.37% over 24 hours—the main story is still with the mainstream coins. I’m 70% confident in this assessment; the remaining 30% is up to the market—if I’m wrong, go easy on me; I’m only watching with a small position.

📰 Just said CPI keeps cooling—August core CPI suddenly spikes: is the rate-cut trade about to crash?

We just discussed CPI cooling yesterday, and today the plot completely flips. According to Crypto Briefing, the U.S. August core CPI came in above market expectations, and overall inflation is running hotter than forecast. In plain terms: the “last mile” of inflation is harder to walk than the Fed thought, and the rate-cut path after September is now clouded.

💡 This is most likely bearish, and the transmission is very direct: core CPI beats expectations → markets scale down the expected size of rate cuts → U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar strengthen → risk asset valuations come under pressure → crypto liquidity tightens.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?

Core CPI is the Fed’s most watched metric because it strips out volatile energy prices. Headline CPI cooling can be pushed down by oil prices, but stubborn core CPI suggests service-sector inflation (rent, wages) is still sticking around. That means the main logic of “inflation falling → rate cuts → easier liquidity → crypto benefits” gets blocked.

What makes it worse is the timing: it lands right before the FOMC rate decision. Traders had been betting on a more aggressive cutting pace, but that bet now needs to be cut back. As rate-cut expectations shrink, the first to get hurt is liquidity-sensitive assets like BTC.

One-sentence translation: the optimistic rate-cut mood built up over the past two months gets marked down to about 70% by this data.

Market impact

In the short term, BTC $77,859 and ETH $2,507 are still holding up (up 1.23% and 3.46% respectively over 24h), which suggests things haven’t immediately collapsed after the data release. But don’t get too excited—CPI’s damage usually isn’t an instant explosion; it shows up gradually after the U.S. session opens and rate-futures reprice.

Historical reference: in September 2023 and April 2024, there were two instances of core CPI coming in above expectations. In the following 12–24 hours, BTC saw a 1.5%–3% pullback. This setup is similar. I expect BTC to face pressure and retest within 12 hours. ETH’s swings will be larger, and within the 24-hour window the upside/liquidity and downside risk coexist.

Trading outlook

🎯 Impact forecast
- Coins: BTC / ETH
- Bias: Bearish 📉 Expect price to fall
- Duration: BTC 12 hours / ETH 24 hours

💡 My stance: slightly bearish in the near term. Watch the $76,000 area for BTC. If the data is favorable and price can still hold above that level within 12 hours, it means the market is absorbing it well and my short thesis would be invalid. Otherwise, if it breaks down and volume increases, the next support to watch is around $74,000. ETH follows BTC, and $2,400 is the key dividing line. I’m only expressing a small-position view—if I’m wrong, go easy on me. I have about a 70% confidence in this call; the remaining 30% is up to the market.

Just when everyone said the shanzhai (copycat) coins would take over, why did the leveraged funds all withdraw from BTC instead?

With shanzhai coin leverage collectively retreating, BTC’s share of holdings rose to 42.1%, and risk-avoidance sentiment is clearly strong.

According to CoinDesk, BTC’s portion in the total open interest across the market has climbed to 42.1%. Put simply: the leveraged positions in shanzhai coins are being massively liquidated, but the money hasn’t left—it’s just been shifted from higher-risk altcoins back into BTC. You can see it in the price action too: BTC is currently $99,33015.66, down 0.94% over 24h, but up 0.7% since midnight. ETH is one of the few large-cap coins that has regained its overnight losses; it’s currently $2,458.02. In the CoinDesk 100, 68 constituent coins turned positive within the day. On Thursday it was 86:14 (more losers than winners), but today it flipped directly.

💡 One-sentence translation: The leveraged bubble in shanzhai coins gets squeezed first, and the surviving capital is concentrating into large-cap assets.

Impact on the market
- Short term: After deleveraging, the market structure is actually healthier. Once the shanzhai liquidation wave settles, the rebound faces less resistance. BTC is still about 6% away from last week’s high of $99,33015.66; in the short term, whether $99.33K can hold is the key.
- Mid term: Clearing shanzhai leverage is usually a prelude to a market regime shift. Funds tend to flow from junk coins back to mainstream assets, and BTC and ETH’s relative strength should continue. ETH didn’t follow the slide this time; it’s flat on the 24h chart at $2,458.02, which is a relatively bullish signal.

My view
I’m bullish on BTC’s next 12 hours. The logic is simple: leverage has been unwound, selling pressure is exhausted, and shanzhai capital is flowing back. Historically, this combination most often corresponds to a period bottoming out. ETH regaining its overnight losses also supports this view. The risk is that if BTC breaks below the $99.33K support, it would mean deleveraging isn’t over yet. I have about a 70% confidence in this call; the remaining 30% is left to the market—I'm only validating with a small position myself.

BTC 跌到 $76,982.9 附近（24h -0.97%）。据 Binance Square 转载 QCP 观点：如果美债收益率反映的是“高利率+无增长”组合，那是比特币最差的环境。10年期美债收益率在 4.94%，美元指数 99.15，今晚 8:30 的 8月 CPI 是关键。

深度解读

为什么这条消息重要？QCP 画的这条线很清楚：收益率高不一定是坏事——如果是增长驱动的，风险资产能扛。但如果收益率高是因为通胀黏性，同时增长在放缓，那就是滞胀剧本。债券抛售→美元走强→风险资产估值承压，这条传导链直通加密市场。传导路径具体是：美债收益率↑ → 资金流向无风险收益 → BTC 这类零现金流资产吸引力下降 → 抛压。下周美联储议息前，今晚 CPI 就是给这条链定价的。

一句话翻译：市场不怕利率高，怕的是利率高还没增长，钱凭什么留在 BTC 里？

历史上 2022 年那轮熊市就是这个配方：收益率飙升+衰退预期，BTC 从高位一路阴跌。现在 4.94% 的十年期收益率离 5% 一步之遥，剧本有点像重播。

Just said the golden cross is a bullish signal—now the data says it’s a distribution signal?

We just discussed the BTC golden cross, but now that we’ve pulled in the full historical data, the conclusion is even more painful: this signal may be specifically designed to mislead.

In one sentence: BTC forms a golden cross this week, but since 2021, every golden cross has been followed by a pullback—without a single exception.

According to data cited by CoinDesk via Binance Square, a golden cross refers to the 50-day moving average crossing above the 200-day moving average—a textbook precursor to a trend turning bullish. But BTC’s actual price action is completely the opposite: most of the upward move occurs before the golden cross forms, and when the signal appears, the rally is basically already over. This time is no different: before the golden cross, BTC rose to $77,092.77; after the signal, the price pulled back to $77,092.77, with a 0.97% drop over 24 hours.

One sentence translation: smart money bought before the golden cross, and by the time retail traders see the signal and enter, they’re exactly left holding the bag.

Market impact:
- Short term: Funds chasing the upside based on technical indicators may get trapped at high levels. The statistical pattern of momentum weakening after a golden cross will strengthen profit-taking behavior, and there’s likely significant sell pressure above $77,092.77
- Medium term: If this time continues to replicate the pattern since 2021, the signal value of the golden cross will further fail. The market will rely more on capital flows and macro data rather than moving-average indicators

My take: I’m bearish on this move. Since 2021, there have been four golden crosses and four pullbacks. The sample size isn’t large, but the directional consistency is too high. For BTC, watch the $77,092.77 support line on the short term; if it breaks, the pullback room opens up. If the rebound can’t reclaim above $77,092.77, the weak structure remains unchanged. I just closed an ETH short-term short position. Not because I’m bearish—but because the on-chain data gave me chills. In the past 4 hours, ETH slid from $2,476.72 to $2,458.57. The drop doesn’t look huge, but the burn rate has climbed against the trend. It feels like what? Like you see someone stepping back on the surface, but they’re constantly throwing money into the fire from their pocket.

Let me start with this trade. I opened the short around $2,476 for a simple reason: the 1-hour candlesticks printed three bearish candles in a row, and the funding rate was still +0.0057%. The longs are paying the shorts—meaning market sentiment is relatively bullish, but the price isn’t rising. That’s a classic short-term divergence. I closed around $2,458 and caught a small segment. But what truly alerted me was what I found after closing—when I checked the burn data. During the price decline, ETH’s burn amount actually didn’t shrink, which is not consistent with the pattern from the past six months. 🔥

Why didn’t the burn rate fall when price dropped? Two possibilities. First, on-chain activity hasn’t cooled down—someone is interacting frequently at this level. It could be arbitrage bots, or it could be real demand. Second, the ETH coming from staking unlocks isn’t flooding into exchanges to dump; instead, some of it went directly into the burn mechanism. Either way, it points to one conclusion: in the $2,405 to $2,458 range, someone is quietly picking up the bids. 24h low $2,405.85, high $2,484.62, amplitude under 3.3%, but the traded volume of 381,163 ETH isn’t small. This combo—tight-range expansion in volume plus a steady burn—often means a trend shift is getting close. 📊

So why did I still close the short? Because the burn data made me too afraid to hold overnight. The biggest fear in short-term trading is that you profit from volatility, but ignore structural changes. If the burn continues, ETH’s circulating supply tightens at the margin. At that time, shorting is essentially fighting deflation. I don’t like going against the fundamentals—even if it’s only short-term. The funding rate of +0.0057% is somewhat bullish, but the magnitude is small, suggesting the longs aren’t especially euphoric. Once that balance gets broken by burn data, the probability of poking upward isn’t low. ⚖️

My plan next: if ETH retraces into the $2,440 to $2,450 area, and the burn amount stays at the current level, I’ll consider testing a long with a small position size, with the stop-loss placed below $2,405. If it directly breaks above $2,484, I won’t chase, because that could be a fake breakout. Short-term trading is like this: it’s better to miss than to make a mistake. The burn variable used to be a long-term narrative, but now it’s increasingly acting like a short-term catalyst—because on-chain data updates in real time, while price is lagging. 💡

One more thing, honestly: the burn isn’t a magic cure-all. But when sentiment is low, it at least gives you a reason not to panic. $ETH  is at this position right now—both bulls and bears have arguments, but the burn data is siding with the bulls.

我刚平掉一笔ETH短线空单，不是因为看空，而是因为链上数据让我后背发凉。过去4小时，ETH从$2,476.72一路阴跌到$2,458.57，跌幅看着不大，但销毁量却在逆势攀升。这感觉就像什么？就像你看到一个人表面在后退，但口袋里一直在往火堆里扔钱。

先说这笔交易。我在$2,476附近开的空，理由很简单：1小时K线三连阴，资金费率还是+0.0057%，多头在付钱给空头，说明市场情绪偏多但价格不涨，典型的短线背离。平仓在$2,458附近，吃到了一小段。但真正让我警觉的，是平仓后我去看了销毁数据——ETH的销毁量在价格下跌时反而没有萎缩，这跟过去半年的规律不太一样。🔥

为什么销毁量在跌的时候不降？两个可能。第一，链上活动没降温，有人在这个位置频繁交互，可能是套利机器人，也可能是真实需求。第二，质押解锁的ETH没有大量涌入交易所砸盘，而是有一部分直接进了销毁通道。不管是哪种，都指向一个结论：$2,405到$2,458这个区间，有人在默默接货。24h最低$2,405.85，最高$2,484.62，振幅不到3.3%，但成交量381,163 ETH不算小。这种窄幅放量+销毁坚挺的组合，短线往往意味着变盘临近。📊

那为什么我还平了空单？因为销毁数据让我不敢隔夜。短线交易最怕的就是你赚了波动的钱，但忽略了结构的变化。如果销毁持续，ETH的流通盘会边际收紧，这时候做空就是在跟通缩对抗。我不喜欢跟基本面对着干，哪怕只是短线。资金费率+0.0057%虽然偏多，但幅度很小，说明多头也没有特别狂热，这种平衡一旦被销毁数据打破，向上插针的概率不低。⚖️

接下来我的计划：如果ETH回踩$2,440到$2,450区间，且销毁量维持当前水平，我会考虑轻仓试多，止损放在$2,405下方。如果直接突破$2,484，我也不会追，因为那可能是假突破。短线就是这样，宁可错过，不要做错。销毁这个变量，以前是长线叙事，现在越来越像短线的催化剂，因为链上数据是实时的，而价格是滞后的。💡

最后说一句实在的：销毁不是万能药，但在情绪低迷的时候，它至少能给你一个不恐慌的理由。$ETH 现在这个位置，多空都有道理，但销毁数据站在多头这边。

$ETH In four hours, a monster needle was taken. From 2433 it was pulled up to 2666, then it was smashed back to 2576. One 4-hour candlestick moved 233 points. Trading volume was 3.72 million ETH, equivalent to $9.5 billion. This is not normal market action. Someone is accumulating, while others are running away.

The board signals are very clear. At this time yesterday, ETH was still churning around 2440. Suddenly, a single bullish candle shot up and directly broke through three integer levels: 2500, 2550, and 2600. The high touched 2666. Then it quickly fell back. The upper wick was 108 points. This kind of move is called a “testing pump,” where the bulls tested how heavy the overhead selling pressure is. The answer: not light. But it didn’t completely wipe out the bulls. The current price is still standing above 2575 and hasn’t fallen back below 2500. That suggests the buying base is still there, even though it got smashed for a wave.

Market sentiment is interesting here. The funding rate is 0.0056%. It’s up 5.26%, yet the funding rate is so low. What does that mean? The shorts haven’t surrendered. A lot of short positions are still open, betting that ETH will drop back. That’s actually a good thing. If the shorts are still there, then if price is pushed higher again, they’ll be forced to liquidate, creating a second squeeze. What the market fears most isn’t that there are more shorts, but that all the shorts run out and there’s nobody left to absorb the selling. Since shorts are still present, they still have ammunition.

Watch the big players by volume and price. That 3.72 million ETH 4h candlestick accounts for more than 60% of the entire day’s volume. Retail can’t eat that kind of size. This is institutional-level orders. Also pay attention: the rally started from 2433, not from 2550. The signs of accumulation at the bottom are obvious. The big player bought a large amount of chips at low levels and pushed them all the way to 2666 in one go. Then what? It didn’t keep pumping; instead, it let the price pull back. There are two possibilities: (1) at 2666 they ran into a real sell wall and needed to digest it; or (2) they deliberately withdrew to shake out the crowd, dumping the followers. I lean toward the second one. During the pullback, the trading volume shrank sharply. The latest 4h candle has only 460k units, one-eighth of the previous one. A volume-decreasing pullback isn’t distribution.

If you break down the volume-price structure: the rally segment was 2433 to 2666 with volume of 3.72 million. The pullback segment was 2666 to 2575 with volume of 460k. The rally volume is 8 times the pullback volume. This is a healthy pattern: expansion on the way up and contraction on the pullback. If it were the opposite—expansion on the pullback and contraction on the rally—then that would be a top signal. That’s not the case now.

Support levels: 2500 and 2460. 2500 is the psychological level, and 2460 is the top edge of yesterday’s consolidation range. As long as those two levels aren’t broken, the bulls’ structure remains intact. The resistance level is 2666. To break it in the short term, more volume is needed.

Let’s add one more layer from the candlestick details. The most recent five 4h candles are: bullish candle, bullish candle, big bullish candle, long upper-wick bullish candle, and a small bullish candle. The overall focus is rising. The lows went from 2433 to 2437 to 2445 to 2450 to 2542—step by step higher. The highs went from 2459 to 2472 to 2483 to 2666 to 2582—also rising. This is the standard structure of an ascending channel. The only issue is that the 2666 candle left a long upper wick. That wick is short-term resistance. But if later they can close a bullish candle with a real body that “eats” that wick, then it turns into “a guiding fairy”—the upper wick isn’t resistance; it’s direction.

ETH doesn’t need my introduction. The elder of smart contracts, a core asset of DeFi, and the key underlying target of the staking track. These labels have been around for too many years. What the market cares about now is ETF inflows and the expansion of the Layer2 ecosystem. But honestly, those narratives are supporting actors compared to price action. This year, ETH fell from 3800 to 2200, then rebounded from 2200 to 2600. It’s range-bound volatility at large scale. Right now it’s testing near the top of the range.

Nini’s plan: current price is 2576. I won’t chase highs. Wait for a pullback into the 2500–2520 range to buy long in batches. Stop loss is at 2430, below the start point of that big bullish candle. The target is 2750–2800 after a breakout above 2666. If it doesn’t pull back to 2520 and instead moves straight up, then I won’t do the trade. The market always has opportunities; it’s not short of this one. A strategy needs to be customized—can find Nini for that.

$ETH 四小时收了根怪物针。从2433拉到2666，又砸回2576。一根K线走了233个点。成交量372万枚ETH，折合95亿美金。这不是正常行情，这是有人在抢筹，也有人在跑路。

盘面信号很明确。昨天这个时候ETH还在2440附近磨。突然一根阳线拔起来，直接突破2500、2550、2600三个整数关口。最高摸到2666。然后迅速回落。上影线108个点。这种走法叫"试探性拉升"——多头试了一下上方的抛压有多重。答案是：不轻。但也没把多头打死。当前价还在2575上方站着，没回到2500以下。说明买盘虽然被砸了一波，底子在。

市场情绪这块有意思。资金费率0.0056%。涨了5.26%，资金费率居然这么低。正常拉盘到这个幅度，费率早飙到0.03%以上了。现在这个数说明什么？空头还没投降。大量空单还开着，赌ETH会跌回去。这反而是好事。空头没走，就意味着如果价格再往上推，他们会被迫平仓，形成二次逼空。市场最怕的不是空头多，是空头都跑光了没人接盘。现在空头还在，弹药充足。

大户动向看量价。那根372万枚的4h K线，占全天成交量的六成以上。散户吃不下这种量。这是机构级别的单子。而且注意，拉升是从2433开始的，不是从2550。底部吃筹的痕迹很明显。大户在低位接了大量筹码，一口气推到2666。然后呢？没继续拉，反而让价格回落了。两种可能：一是在2666附近遇到了真正的卖墙，需要消化；二是主动回撤洗盘，把跟风盘甩下去。我倾向后者。因为回撤过程中成交量急剧萎缩，最新一根4h K线只有46万枚，是前一根的八分之一。缩量回调，不是出货。

量价结构拆开看。拉升段：2433到2666，量372万枚。回调段：2666回到2575，量46万枚。拉升量是回调量的8倍。这是健康的放量上涨缩量回调形态。如果反过来——拉升缩量回调放量——那才是见顶信号。现在不是。支撑位看2500和2460。2500是心理关口，2460是昨天 consolidation 区间上沿。只要这两个位置不破，多头结构完好。压力位2666，短期要想突破需要再堆量。

K线细节再说一层。最近5根4h K线：阳线、阳线、大阳线、长上影阳线、小阳线。重心在抬高。低点从2433到2437到2445到2450到2542，逐步上移。高点从2459到2472到2483到2666到2582，也在上移。这是上升通道的标准结构。唯一的问题是2666那根留下了长上影。这根上影线短期是压力。但如果后面能收一根实体阳线吃掉上影，那就变成"仙人指路"——上影不是压力，是方向。

ETH不需要我介绍。智能合约的老祖宗，DeFi的底层资产，质押赛道的核心标的。这些标签贴了太多年，现在市场更关心的是ETF资金流入和Layer2生态的扩张。但说实话，这些叙事在价格面前都是配角。ETH今年从3800跌到2200，又从2200拉回2600。大区间震荡。现在就是在区间上沿试探。

妮妮的计划：当前价2576。我不追高。等回调到2500-2520区间分批接多。止损放在2430，也就是那根大阳线的起涨点下方。目标看2666突破后的2750-2800。如果回调不到2520就直接往上走，那就不做。市场永远有机会，不差这一单。有策略需要定制，可以找妮妮。

For people who already hold positions, the key is to manage based on whether support fails, not to be swept along by every fluctuation. In this Ethereum rebound, one key driver has appeared behind the move: shorts are starting to get liquidated at massive scale. 
On September 11, ETH climbed as much as about 8.3% intraday, breaking back above $2,600. 

At the same time, in the past 24 hours, ETH short positions have been liquidated over: 
💥 $255 million 

Even more extreme, about $188 million of the short liquidations were concentrated within just a single hour. 
This is the classic sequence of: 
ETH rising 
↓ 
Shorts stop out / get liquidated 
↓ 
Forced buyback of ETH 
↓ 
Further pushes the price higher 
↓ 
More shorts get liquidated 
↓ 
Forming a “short squeeze” 
So this time, ETH’s rally isn’t driven only by spot buying pressure. 

Even closing short positions becomes a buying force. 
What’s more interesting is that ETH had already gone through a clear round of gains beforehand. 
According to Reuters data, ETH had cumulatively risen by about 37% over the previous 10 days, then entered a consolidation around the $2,500 level. 

Now it’s launching another push above $2,600, which suggests that the market’s battle between bulls and bears is intensifying significantly. 

But it’s also important to note this: 
Short liquidations can accelerate the rally, but they can’t, on their own, determine the overall trend. 
If spot capital and ETF inflows continue to follow through afterward, this squeeze could evolve further into a trend-driven move. 

On the other hand, if the buying demand rapidly fades after short liquidations end, ETH could return to a range-bound consolidation. 

So the most worth watching next isn’t: 
“How many more shorts will get liquidated?” 

Instead, it’s: 
After the shorts are fully cleared out, is there any new, real buying to keep the momentum going? 
If there is, then the value of this ETH rebound is much higher. 
Short liquidations are just the fuel—the real engine is sustained buying pressure.

TRON has brought Ethena’s USDe and sUSDe to its own chain, ushering in a new phase of stablecoin competition.

According to Crypto Briefing, TRON announced that it is integrating Ethena’s USDe and sUSDe, enabling seamless cross-chain bridging. In simple terms, USDe—a synthetic dollar supported by “basis trading + treasury yield”—can now be used directly within the TRON ecosystem.

TRON is one of the public chains with the largest stablecoin settlement volume across the whole chain. USDT’s circulating supply on it has long ranked in the industry’s top tier. With the introduction of USDe, TRON users effectively gain another option for “yield-bearing dollars.” sUSDe’s annualized returns have even been able to outperform U.S. Treasuries in the recent period, which is attractive for stablecoin capital that’s been sitting idle in wallets.

One-sentence translation: TRON doesn’t want to put all its eggs in the USDT basket, and Ethena also needs TRON’s settlement highway.

- Short term: A sentiment-positive boost for the ENA ecosystem and TRON’s DeFi. Improved cross-chain liquidity may lead to a slight rebound in the TVL of related protocols. Bitcoin faces $81,700 resistance at its 365-day moving average, a level that remains crucial for confirming a new bull market. The 3x Metcalfe band at $83,600 represents the next valuation ceiling, following Bitcoin's stalled advance toward the 365-day moving average. The supply wall between $77,100 and $80,200 has seen 539,000 BTC sold by long-term holders in 2026, making the range a key overhead resistance.Bitcoin (BTC) has paused between $76,000 and $82,000, as several key resistance levels converge above spot price. Bitcoin's 365-day moving average sets key resistance at $81.7KThe top crypto faces its first major technical hurdle with the 365-day moving average, which currently stands at $81,700, according to a Friday report from CryptoQuant. The report noted that Bitcoin's bull markets have historically begun when price closes above the 365-day moving average, while the 200-day moving average at $70,000 remains the key technical support."The 365-day moving average is the first major resistance Bitcoin must overcome to confirm the new bull market," CryptoQuant wrote. The recent rally pushed Bitcoin toward the 365-day moving average, where price stalled, and the level acted as resistance."A decisive break above it would confirm the new bull market and open room for a new leg up; a rejection keeps Bitcoin range-bound," the report stated. Bitcoin's next valuation hurdle sits at $83.6KCryptoQuant added that $70,000 remains the technical floor to defend. Beyond the 365-day moving average, Bitcoin faces another resistance level at $83,600 based on the 3x Metcalfe band. The band measures Bitcoin's network value using active addresses, with the 3x band now sitting just above the 365-day moving average.Bitcoin: Metcalfe Price Valuation Bands. Source: CryptoQuantCryptoQuant noted that the 3x Metcalfe band stood at $138,000 when Bitcoin reached its $126,000 all-time high in October 2025. The 2x band also aligned with Bitcoin's price when the cryptocurrency first reached $100,000 in December 2024."With price near $78K, the 3x band is the valuation ceiling to clear," the report said. The top crypto also faces potential selling pressure as it approaches the upper band of the trader realized price, currently at $88,700. The metric tracks the cost basis of active traders, with Bitcoin currently positioned between the realized price of $63,400 and its upper band. The report stated that unrealized profit margins become increasingly stretched as price approaches the upper band, historically leading to stronger selling. The report therefore identifies $88,700 as a firm resistance level for any further extension."The lower ($55.8K) and minimum ($39.9K) bands sit well below current levels, underscoring that the near-term risk is overhead, not below," CryptoQuant shared. Bitcoin's most immediate obstacle, however, is an on-chain supply wall between $77,100 and $80,200 by long-term holders (LTH). CryptoQuant highlighted that up to 539,000 BTC were sold during a 30-day period in 2026, making it the nearest and heaviest supply resistance above the current price. Rate cuts haven’t arrived yet—so why is Wall Street already betting on consecutive rate hikes in the first half of 2026?

The WSJ says the market has begun pricing in a series of rate hikes before mid-2026. Expectations of tighter liquidity directly drag down crypto valuations.

According to a WSJ report, the market is preparing for the possibility that the Federal Reserve could continue raising rates consecutively in the first half of 2026. In plain terms: the easing cycle everyone was hoping for may not only fail to continue—it may even be reversed. Rate hikes mean borrowing costs rise and financial conditions tighten, so risk assets’ valuations get cut first. The transmission path is straightforward: rate-hike expectations → stronger U.S. dollar interest rates and a firmer U.S. dollar index → global liquidity contraction → pressure on high-beta assets like crypto. BTC is currently $77,288, up only 0.75% in the past 24 hours, clearly underperforming ETH’s 2.92% gain and BNB’s 3.34%.

One-sentence translation: the faucet might be turned off—don’t rush to add valuation to risk assets.

Impact on the market
- Short term: This “expectations being priced in” phase is the most painful. You don’t even need to wait for actual hikes—the market will trim positions on its own first. There’s not a small amount of pressure above BTC; around $78,000 is near-term resistance. If $75,000 is broken, leveraged positions will accelerate their liquidation and clearing.
- Medium term: If the rate-hike path becomes firmly established, the valuation cuts will hit the highest-valued altcoins and long-tail projects the hardest. Funds may concentrate into BTC and ETH as a safe-haven. At the same time, the underperformance of staking yield relative to U.S. Treasury yields will be amplified, and on-chain capital may continue to flow back to traditional markets.

My view
I’m fairly cautious. In the short term, the risk of a pullback is higher than the probability of continued upside. In terms of the data, BTC’s 0.75% rise today stands out against a backdrop where altcoins generally are up 2–3%; that in itself is a signal of defensive positioning. ETH is relatively stronger, and support around $2,400 is key. My confidence is about 70%; the remaining 30% depends on the messaging from Fed officials over the next few weeks—if they sound a bit looser, this batch of rate-hike “bad news” pricing could be delayed.

#以太坊时隔七个月重返2600美元 

Honestly, when $ETH  scraped back up to $2,600, my first reaction wasn’t “the bull run is back.” It was: this guy finally woke up.

Over the past half year or so, when Bitcoin had momentum, ETH often couldn’t keep up. And when altcoins went off the rails, ETH would get dragged down too. When things rose, ETH was criticized for moving too slowly; when things fell, it didn’t miss a beat. A lot of people holding ETH probably feel like they’ve been ground down to the point of having no patience left.

So this time, getting back above $2,600 isn’t just about a few percentage points of gains.

Most importantly, the market is starting to reprice ETH again.

Especially after grinding in the 2,500–2,560 range for so long—once that selling pressure is truly absorbed, the room for imagination and upside naturally opens up. Now I’m actually not too fixated on whether ETH is up 5% today or pulls back 3% tomorrow. What I care about is whether $2,600 can turn from a resistance level into support.

If later on it retraces near $2,600 and can still hold, then $3,000 really isn’t just a hype target—it’s a price the market will eventually test.

Of course, I don’t think it’s a good time to blindly chase right now.

ETH is the kind of coin that loves doing one thing: when you don’t believe, it keeps climbing. Then once you finally can’t resist and FOMO in, it suddenly hits you with a big red candle to slap you in the face.

And on top of that, there are still plenty of threats outside: rate-hike expectations from the Fed, Treasury yields, geopolitical conflicts—so the macro environment doesn’t feel comfortable.

But one thing I’m getting more and more certain about:

If this round allows ETH to truly break out with independent strength, then what could get the most comfortable later on might not just be ETH—it could be the entire altcoin market.

Because $BTC  is the one bringing the money in. Once ETH starts to take the baton, capital may finally diffuse downward for real.

So I’m not treating $2,600 as the finish line.

I’d rather see it as a door.

The door has just cracked open. Next, we’ll see whether ETH has what it takes to put $3,000 back on the table.
